# NextPlay Results

> Legal support services team — twenty years in the trenches. Demand letters, medical chronologies, pleadings, motions, discovery, tort claim notices, case management setup, and legal AI coaching for law firms. Done right, done fast.

Contact: team@nextplayresults.com · +1-415-545-8434 · https://nextplayresults.com

## Services

- Demand Letter Drafting — AI-assisted drafting with human-led quality control; every citation checked, every damages number verified by the team.
- Medical Chronology (MedChron) — standardized, searchable medical-record timelines; every page verified against source Bates numbers.
- Pleadings, Motions & Discovery — litigation drafting support.
- Tort Claim Notices — deadline-sensitive government claim notices.
- Case Management Setup — practice/case management system configuration.
- Legal AI Coaching — secure, matter-scoped AI setup and training for firms.
- Lemon Law Claims — consumer protection and manufacturer buyback documentation.

## About the team

Our team — licensed, twenty years in the trenches. Mostly personal injury, medical malpractice, and workers' compensation, with corporate, probate, and insurance defense experience. We've written over 1,000 demand letters, prepped for 250+ trials, and sat through 20 of them in court. Every project gets senior eyes on it before it goes out.

## FAQ

**Who actually does the work?**
Our team — licensed, twenty years in the trenches. Every project gets senior eyes on it before it goes out.

**Do you just use ChatGPT or AI templates?**
No. We use AI to speed up research and initial drafts, then read and rewrite everything. Citations are checked; damages math is done by the team.

**How do you handle confidential client information?**
HIPAA-compliant workflows, encrypted file transfer, NDAs standard, strict matter-scoped processes. Attorney-client privilege maintained throughout.

**What jurisdictions do you cover?**
All 50 US states — venue-specific case law, statutes, and procedural requirements.

**What's your typical turnaround time?**
Demand letters 24–48 hours; medical chronologies 2–5 days depending on record volume. Rush available on request.

**What if I'm not satisfied with the work?**
First revision always included; after that we fix it or refund it.

## Practice areas served

Motor vehicle accidents, commercial/trucking accidents, boating accidents, premises liability, slip and falls, dog bites, medical malpractice, nursing home neglect/abuse, dram shop claims, construction defect, products liability, workplace accidents, insurance defense, tenant rights law, lemon law, probate, guardianships.
